quickAdd.hint: Separate with commas or spaces. 1-20 is a range and 45x2 is two copies. Other rarities use their short name and number: SCR12 is card 12’s Secret Rare, and ranges work too (QCSR1-QCSR20).
quickAdd.empty: Cards run from RA03-EN001 to RA03-EN276.

help.tiers: Standard or Master: pick what you’re collecting above the cards. Standard is the 276 cards, each in its main rarity. Master adds the 660 other rarities. Cards you’ve marked are kept when you switch.

about.title: About the Quarter Century Bonanza set
paragraphs: Quarter Century Bonanza is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG special set released on 7 November 2024, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 276 cards, and with the 660 other rarities there are 936 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 276 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 936, adding the 660 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
